note: Recast from the revision by Constantino (1995), the original in English. That work describes the soldier; the alate is recorded as unknown there (Imago. Unknown.). Soldier measurements: 2 soldiers from 2 colonies, head length 6.30—6.80 mm, maximum head width 5.90—6.20 mm, head height without the postmentum 3.30—3.80 mm, frontal tube length 0.25—0.29 mm, left mandible length 2.60—2.70 mm, curvature 1.05—1.10 mm, left mandible M1—M2 distance 0.72 mm, left mandible width 0.99—1.06 mm. The original marks the species as new (new species).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The most similar soldier is S. brevimalatus, which has shorter mandibles, a more elongate head, sparser pilosity on the head and thorax, and smaller marginal teeth on both mandibles. The distinctive character of the soldier of this species is the large, fleshy labrum.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule elongate, the sides narrowing slightly forwards or nearly parallel; posterior margin of the head nearly round. Frontal tube prominent, the opening not visible in dorsal view. Labrum large and fleshy, longer than wide, the corners rounded; midlobe short. Antenna 19—20 segments. Postmentum not constricted.
